result.Method of Attack: Preinstall script executes a malicious .js file that downloads a malicious DLL payload from a C2 server; Uses curl to download a DLL disguised as package.db; Loads malicious DLL via rundll32.exe (System Binary Proxy Execution); Deletes evidence files and restores original package.json from pk.json; DLL contains anti-debugging API calls but no active malicious code, likely a test or unfinished payload
result.Attack Vector: Malicious npm package installation leveraging preinstall script; Downloading and executing payload from HTTP C2 server

Indicators of Compromise.Malicious Files: Temp.b (renamed to package.db DLL) with SHA256 d2a74db6b9c900ad29a81432af72eee8ed4e22bf61055e7e8f7a5f1a33778277
Indicators of Compromise.Technique: Use of rundll32.exe to load DLL
